G0400.def:
ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;] 
to cry out, exclaim: Luc 1:42 (Arist., al.).†

G0401.def:
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out), 
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, 1 Pierre 4:4 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0402.def:
ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;] 
__1. to go back. 
__2. to withdraw: Matthieu 9:24; frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), Matthieu 2:12 (but see Thayer), Matthieu 2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5, Marc 3:7, Jean 6:15, Actes 23:19 26:31.†

G0404.def:
ἀνα-ψύχω 
[in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;] 
to refresh: with accusative of person(s), 2 Timothée 1:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).†

G0405.def:
ἀνδραποδιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war) 
a slave-dealer, kidnapper: 1 Timothée 1:10 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0406.def:
Ἀνδρέας, -ου, ὁ 
Andrew, the Apostle: Matthieu 4:18 10:2, Marc 1:16, 29 3:18 13:3, Luc 6:14, Jean 1:41, 45 6:8 12:22, Actes 1:13.†

G0407.def:
ἀνδρίζω 
[in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ (Josué 1:6 ff., 1 Chroniques 22:19, al.; in 2 Rois 10:12, Psaumes 27:14 31:24 combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;] 
to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 1 Corinthiens 16:13.†

G0409.def:
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.9:28 * ;] 
a man-slayer: 1 Timothée 1:9 (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0410.def:
ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:31 * ;] 
not to be called to account, unreprovable: 1 Corinthiens 1:8, Colossiens 1:22, 1 Timothée 3:10, Tite 1:6-7.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word)

G0411.def:
ἀν-εκδιήγητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι) 
inexpressible: 2 Corinthiens 9:15 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0413.def:
ἀνέκλειπτος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐκλείπω), 
unfailing: Luc 12:33 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0414.def:
αν-εκτός, -όν
(also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; ἀνέχομαι), 
tolerable: compar., -ότερος, Matthieu 10:15 11:22, 24, Luc 10:12, 14 †

G0415.def:
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον
(-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר ;] 
without mercy: Romains 1:13.†

G0416.def:
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος); 
pass., 
to be driven by the wind: Jacques 1:6.†

G0417.def:
ἄνεμος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for רוּחַ ;] 
wind: Matthieu 11:7 14:24, 30 14:32, Marc 4:37, 39 4:41 6:48, 51, Luc 7:24 8:23-24, Jean 6:13, Actes 27:7, 14-15, Jacques 3:4, Apocalypse 6:13 7:1; pl., Matthieu 7:25, 27 8:26-27, Luc 8:25, Actes 27:4, Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, Apocalypse 7:1; hence the four quarters of the heavens (see Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, see word), Matthieu 24:31, Marc 13:27; metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414.†
SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ).

G0418.def:
ἀν-ένδεκτος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἔνδεκτος; ἐνδέχομαι), 
impossible, inadmissible: Luc 17:1.†

G0419.def:
ἀνεξεραύνητος
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3 * ;] 
unsearchable: Romains 11:33.†

G0420.def:
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός) 
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): 2 Timothée 2:24.†

G0421.def:
ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: Job 5:9 9:10 34:24 (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;] 
that cannot be traced out: Romains 11:33, Éphésiens 3:8 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0422.def:
ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον
(ἐπαισχύνομαι) 
not to be put to shame: 2 Timothée 2:15.†

G0423.def:
ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον 
(ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω) 
without reproach: 1 Timothée 3:2 5:7 6:14.†
SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word).

G0424.def:
ἀν-έρχομαι 
[in LXX: 3Ki.13:12 (הָלַךְ)* ;] 
to go up: Jean 6:3, Galates 1:17-18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).†

G0425.def:
ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀνίημι), [in LXX: 2Es.4.22 (שָׁלוּ), 2 Chroniques 23:15, I Esther 4:62, Wis.13:13, Sir.15:20 26:10 * ;] 
a loosening, relaxation: Actes 24:23 (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: 2 Corinthiens 2:12 7:5 8:13, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:7.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).†

G0426.def:
ἀν-ετάζω
(ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Juges 6:29 (דָּרַשׁ), Esther 2:23 (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH Su 1:14 * ;] 
to examine judicially: Actes 22:24, 29..†

G0427.def:
ἄνευ 
prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on Éphésiens 2:12; MM, VGT, 42), 
without: Matthieu 10:29, 1 Pierre 3:1 4:9.†

G0428.def:
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
(see MM, VGT, see word) 
not well placed, not fit: Actes 27:12.†

G0429.def:
ἀν-ευρίσκω
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:14 * ;] 
to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): Luc 2:16, Actes 21:4.†

G0430.def:
ἀν-έχω 
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;] 
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 17:17, Marc 9:19, Luc 9:41, 2 Corinthiens 11:1 11:19, Éphésiens 4:2, Colossiens 3:13; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), 2 Corinthiens 11:1; with dative of thing(s), 2 Thessaloniciens 1:4 (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, 2 Corinthiens 11:20; absol., 1 Corinthiens 4:12, 2 Corinthiens 11:4; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), Actes 18:14; with genitive of thing(s), 2 Timothée 4:3, Hébreux 13:22 (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).†

G0431.def:
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Nombres 36:11 ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7:2 9:6 א * ;] 
a cousin: Colossiens 4:10 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0432.def: anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0433.def:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Josué 23:14 (בּוֹא), 1 Rois 27:8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;] 
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Éphésiens 5:4, Colossiens 3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†

G0434.def:
ἀν-ήμερος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἥμερο ), 
not tame, savage (MM, VGT, see word): 2 Timothée 3:3.†

G0435G.def:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;] 
a man, Lat. vir. 
__1. As opposite to a woman, Actes 8:12, 1 Timothée 2:12; as a husband, Matthieu 1:16, Jean 4:16, Romains 7:2, Tite 1:6. 
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1 Corinthiens 13:11, Éphésiens 4:13, Jacques 3:2. 
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luc 5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Actes 1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Actes 22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35. 
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Luc 8:41, Actes 6:11. 
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word).

G0435H.def:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;] 
a man, Lat. vir. 
__1. As opposite to a woman, Actes 8:12, 1 Timothée 2:12; as a husband, Matthieu 1:16, Jean 4:16, Romains 7:2, Tite 1:6. 
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1 Corinthiens 13:11, Éphésiens 4:13, Jacques 3:2. 
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luc 5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Actes 1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Actes 22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35. 
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Luc 8:41, Actes 6:11. 
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word).

G0436.def:
ἀνθ-ίοτημι
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;] 
__1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against. 
__2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, Matthieu 5:39, Luc 21:15, Actes 6:10 13:8, Romains 9:19 13:2, Galates 2:11, Éphésiens 6:13, 2 Timothée 3:8 4:15, Jacques 4:7, 1 Pierre 5:9.†

G0437.def:
ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: Psaumes 79:13 (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I Esther 8:91, Sir.20:2, 3Ma.6:33 * ;] 
__1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.). 
__2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with). 
__3. C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): Luc 2:38 (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0438.def:
ἄνθος, -εος, τό 
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;] 
a flower: Jacques 1:10-11. 1 Pierre 1:24" (LXX) .†

G0439.def:
ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11:32, 4Ma.9:20 * ;] 
a heap of burning coals: Jean 18:18 21:9.†

G0440.def:
ἄνθραξ, -ακος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for גֶּחֶל ;] 
coal, charcoal: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, Romains 12:20.†

G0441.def:
ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: Psaumes 53:5 * ;] 
studying to please men: Éphésiens 6:6, Colossiens 3:22 (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0442.def:
ἀνθρώπινος, -η, ον
(ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ ;] 
human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, Actes 17:25; σοφία, 1 Corinthiens 2:13; φύσις, Jacques 3:7; κτίσις, 1 Pierre 2:13 (MM, VGT, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. (1 Corinthiens 3:13, God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, 1 Corinthiens 4:3 (see Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, Notes, 175), 1 Corinthiens 10:13; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, Romains 6:19 (see Field, Notes, 156).†

G0443.def:
ἀνθρωποκτόνος, -ον
(κτείνω, to kill) 
a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): Jean 8:44, 1 Jean 3:16.† 
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83)

G0444.def:
ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;] 
man: 
__1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): Jean 16:21; with art., Matthieu 4:4 12:35, Marc 2:27, Jean 2:25, Romains 7:1, al; disting. from God, Matthieu 19:6, Jean 10:33, Colossiens 3:23, al.; from animals, etc., Matthieu 4:19, Luc 5:10, Apocalypse 9:4, al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, 1 Corinthiens 3:4; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, 1 Corinthiens 2:5; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, 1 Pierre 4:2; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, 1 Corinthiens 3:3; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), Romains 3:5, 1 Corinthiens 9:8; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, Galates 3:15 (cf. 1 Corinthiens 15:32, Galates 1:11); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., Romains 7:22, Éphésiens 3:16, 2 Corinthiens 4:16 (cf. 1 Pierre 3:4); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., Romains 6:6, Éphésiens 2:15 4:22, 24 Colossiens 3:9, 10; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, Matthieu 13:45 (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, Matthieu 13:52; βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, Matthieu 27:32; Ἰουδαῖος, Actes 21:39; Ῥωμαῖος, Actes 16:37; pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: Matthieu 5:13, 16 Marc 8:24, Jean 4:28; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, Marc 11:2, 1 Timothée 6:16. 
__2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: Matthieu 17:14, Marc 12:1, al.; τις ἄ., Matthieu 18:12, Jean 5:5, al.; indef. one (Fr. on), Romains 3:28, Galates 2:16, al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., Matthieu 10:36 19:10, Jean 7:22, 23. 
__3. Definitely, with art., of some particular person; Matthieu 12:13, Marc 3:5, al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., Luc 14:30; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, Marc 14:71, Matthieu 12:45; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), 1 Timothée 6:11, 2 Timothée 3:17, 2 Pierre 1:21; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός. 
SYN.: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635).

G0446.def:
ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος), 
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): Actes 13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38.†

G0447.def:
ἀν-ίημι
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 
__1. to send up, produce, to send back. 
__2. to let go, leave without support: Hébreux 13:5 (cf. Deutéronome 31:6; Hom., Iliad., ii, 71). 
__3. to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): Actes 16:26 27:40; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: Éphésiens 6:9.†

G0448.def:
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word), 
merciless: Jacques 2:13.†

G0449.def:
ἄνιπτος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νίπτω), 
unwashed: Matthieu 15:20, Marc 7:5 (5 Rec).†

G0450.def:
ἀνίστημι (ἀνά, ἵστημι), 
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 
__1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: Actes 9:41; from death, Jean 6:39, Actes 2:32; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: Matthieu 22:24, Actes 3:22, 26. 
__2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.; 
__(a) to rise: from lying, Marc 1:35; from sitting, Luc 4:16; to leave a place, Matthieu 9:9; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, Marc 10:1, al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, Matthieu 17:23, Marc 8:31; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, Matthieu 17:9, Marc 9:9; 
__(b) to arise, appear: Actes 5:36, Romains 15:12 (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, see word). 
SYN.: ἐγείρω.

G0451.def:
Ἄννα, -ας, ἡ (Heb. חָנָה), 
Anna, a prophetess: Luc 2:36.†

G0452.def:
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן), 
Annas, the high priest: Luc 3:2, Jean 18:13-24, Actes 4:6.†

G0453.def:
ἀ-νόητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 17:28 (אֱוִיל), Sir.42:8, al. ;] 
__1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.). 
__2. not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): Luc 24:25, Romains 1:14, Galates 3:1, 3, 1 Timothée 6:9, Tite 3:3 (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv)

G0454.def:
ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: Proverbes 14:8, 2215 (אִוֶּלֶת), Wis.15:18, al. ;] 
folly, foolishness: 2 Timothée 3:9; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): Luc 6:11.†

G0455.def:
ἀν-οίγω
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;] 
to open; 
__1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, Actes 5:19 12:14, Apocalypse 4:1; pass., Actes 12:10 16:26-27; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, Actes 14:27, Colossiens 4:3, Apocalypse 3:20; pass., 1 Corinthiens 16:9, 2 Corinthiens 2:12, Apocalypse 3:8; absol. (sc. θύραν), Actes 5:23 12:16; with dative of person(s), Luc 12:36, Jean 10:3; metaphorically, Matthieu 7:7-8 25:11, Luc 11:9-10 13:25, Apocalypse 3:7; θησαυρούς (Sir.43:14), Matthieu 2:11; τ. μνημεῖα, Matthieu 27:52; τάφος, Romains 3:13; τ. φρέαρ, Apocalypse 9:2; of heaven, Matthieu 3:16, Luc 3:21, Actes 10:11, Apocalypse 11:19 15:5 19:11; σφραγῖδα, Apocalypse 5:9 6:1 ff. Apocalypse 8:1; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, Luc 4:17, Apocalypse 5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12; τ. στόμα, Matthieu 17:27; id. Hebraistically (Nombres 22:28, Job 3:1, Ésaïe 50:5, al.), of beginning to speak, Matthieu 5:2, Actes 8:32, 35 10:34 18:14; before εἰς βλαιφημίας, Apocalypse 13:6; ἐν παραβολαῖς (Psaumes 78:2), Matthieu 13:35; of recovering speech, Luc 1:64; of the earth opening, Apocalypse 12:16; τ. ὀφθαλμoύς, Actes 9:8, 40; id. with genitive of person(s), of restoring sight, Matthieu 9:30 20:33, Jean 9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37ff ; metaphorically, Actes 26:18; ἀκοάς, with genitive of person(s), of restoring hearing, Marc 7:35. 
__2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, Pr., 154); heaven, Jean 1:51; τ. στόμα, before πρός, of speaking freely, 2 Corinthiens 6:11 (cf. δι-ανοίγω and see MM, VGT, 45).†

G0456.def:
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;] 
to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): Actes 15:16.†

G0457.def:
ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνοίγω), 
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Éphésiens 6:19.†

G0458.def:
ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] 
lawlessness, iniquity: Matthieu 7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12, Romains 6:19, 2 Corinthiens 6:14, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3 2:7, Tite 2:14, Hébreux 1:9, 1 Jean 3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Psaumes 31:1, al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Romains 4:7 (LXX), Hébreux 10:17.†
SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος

G0459.def:
ἄ-νομος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] 
__1. lawless, wicked: Marc 15:28, Luc 22:37, Actes 2:23, 1 Timothée 1:9, 2 Pierre 2:8; ὁ ἄ., 2 Thessaloniciens 2:8 (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3). 
__2. without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, Romains 2:14): 1 Corinthiens 9:21 (MM, VGT, see word). 
† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος

G0460.def:
ἀνόμως, 
adv. [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;] 
__1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with). 
__2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: Romains 2:12.†

G0461.def:
ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;] 
to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, Luc 13:13, Hébreux 12:12; of things, σκηνήν, Actes 15:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 807).†

G0462.def:
ἀν-όσιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: Eze.22:9 (זִמָּה, Wis.12:4, 2Ma.7:34 2Mac 8:32, 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 5:7, 4Ma.12:11 * ;] 
unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): 1 Timothée 1:9, 2 Timothée 3:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0463.def:
ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:25 (RV, respite)* ;] 
__1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, see word). 
__2. forbearance, delay of punishment: Romains 2:4 3:26.†
SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47).

G0464.def:
ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι depon., 
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:14 * ;] 
to struggle against: before πρός, with accusative, Hébreux 12:4.†

G0465.def:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;] 
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Matthieu 16:26, Marc 8:37 (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).†

G0466.def:
ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω), 
to fill up in turn: Colossiens 1:24 (see Lft., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0469.def:
ἀντ-από-δοσις, -εως, ἡ
(see supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם ;] 
recompense: Colossiens 3:24 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0470.def:
ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: Juges 5:29, Job 16:9 (8) Job 32:12 (עָנָה)* ;] 
to answer again, reply against: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), Luc 14:6; with dative of person(s), Romains 9:20.†

G0471.def:
ἀντ-εῖπον
(άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;] 
__2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: Luc 21:15, Actes 4:14.†

G0472.def:
ἀντ-ὲχω
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to hold against. 
__2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against. 
__3. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to hold firmly to, cleave to: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), Matthieu 6:24, Luc 16:13, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:14 (see M, Th., in l), Tite 1:9.†

G0473.def:
ἀντί
(the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. with genitive (cf. MM, VGT, see word); 
__1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence 
__2. instead of, in place of, for (Hom., etc.): Matthieu 5:38 17:27, Luc 11:11, 1 Corinthiens 11:15, Hébreux 12:2; with artic. inf. (cl.), Jacques 4:15; of succession, Matthieu 2:22; χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, Jean 1:16 (M, Pr., 100); of price in exchange, Hébreux 12:16; λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, Matthieu 20:28, Marc 10:45 (M, Pr., 105); of requital, Romains 12:17, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:16, 1 Pierre 3:9 (cf. Wis.11:15); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, Luc 1:20 19:44, Actes 12:23, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:10 (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), Luc 12:3; ἀ. τούτου (LXX for כֵּן נַעֲרָה)Éphésiens 5:31. As a prefix, ἀντι- (before vowels ἀντ-, ἀνθ᾽-), denotes 
__(a) over against, ἀντιπέραν; 
__(b) co-operation, ἀντιβάλλειν; 
__(with) requital, ἀντιμισθία; 
__(d) opposition, ἀντίχριστος; 
__(e) substitution, ἀνθύπατος. 
Compounds of ἀ. usually govern dative (B1., § 37, 7).†

G0474.def:
ἀντι-βάλλω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:13 * ;] 
to throw in turn, exchange: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, Notes, 81), Luc 24:17.†

G0475.def:
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι 
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: 2 Timothée 2:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word)

G0476.def:
ἀντίδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;] 
as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: Matthieu 5:25, Luc 12:58 18:3, 1 Pierre 5:8 (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0480.def:
ἀντί-κειμαι 
[in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;] 
__1. to lie opposite to. 
__2. to oppose, withstand, resist: with dative, Luc 13:17 21:15, Galates 5:17, 1 Timothée 1:10; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, 1 Corinthiens 16:9, Philippiens 1:28, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:4, 1 Timothée 5:14 (Cremer, 746).†

G0481.def:
ἄντικρυς
(Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: Néhémie 12:8 (נֶגֶד), 3Ma.5:16 * ;] 
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: Actes 20:15 (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0483.def:
ἀντι-λέγω 
[in LXX: Osée 4:4 (רִיב hi.), Ésaïe 50:5 (סוּג ni.) Ésaïe 22:22 65:2, Sir.4:25, 3Ma.2:28, 4Ma.4:7 4Mac 8:2 * ;] 
cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: Actes 28:19, Romains 10:21, Tite 1:9 2:9; with dative, Jean 19:12, Actes 13:45; with accusative and inf., Luc 20:27 T; pass., Luc 2:34, Actes 28:22.†

G0484.def:
ἀντί-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ 
(ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in Psaumes 2:1-12,3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;] 
__1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange. 
__2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; 1 Corinthiens 12:28 (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†

G0485.def:
ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ
(ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;] 
gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, VGT, see word; cf. Field, Notes, 106): Hébreux 6:16 7:7 12:3, Ju 11.†

G0486.def: to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)

G0487.def:
ἀντί-λυτρον, -ου, τό 
[in Al.: Psaumes 49:9 * ;] 
a ransom: 1 Timothée 2:6 (see CGT, in l; and cf. λύτρον).†

G0488.def:
ἀντι-μετρέω, -ῶ 
to measure in return: Luc 6:38 (WH, mg., μετρέω).†

G0489.def:
ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀντίμισθος, for a reward) 
a reward, requital: in good sense, 2 Corinthiens 6:13; in bad sense, Romains 1:27 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0490G.def:
Ἀντιόχεια, -ας, ἡ 
Antioch; 
__1. in Syria: Actes 11:19-22, 26-27 13:1 14:26 15:22-23, 30 15:35 18:22, Galates 2:11 
__2. In Pisidia: Actes 13:14 14:19, 21, 2 Timothée 3:11.†

G0490H.def:
Ἀντιόχεια, -ας, ἡ 
Antioch; 
__1. in Syria: Actes 11:19-22, 26-27 13:1 14:26 15:22-23, 30 15:35 18:22, Galates 2:11 
__2. In Pisidia: Actes 13:14 14:19, 21, 2 Timothée 3:11.†

G0491.def:
Ἀντιοχεύς, -έως, ὁ 
a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian: Actes 6:5.†

G0492.def:
ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι 
[in LXX: Wis.16:10 * ;] 
to pass by opposite to: Luc 10:31-32 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0493.def:
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, Proverbes 12:1-28; it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ, 
Antipas: Apocalypse 2:13.†

G0494.def:
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: Actes 23:31.†

G0495.def:
ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49), 
on the opposite side: with genitive, Luc 8:26.†

G0496.def:
ἀντι-πίπτω 
[in LXX: Exode 26:5 (קָבַל), Exode 26:17 (שׁוּב), Nombres 27:14 (מְרִיבָה) Job 23:13 (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;] 
__1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.). 
__2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, Actes 7:51

G0497.def:
ἀντι-στρατεύομαι 
to make war against: with dative, Romains 7:23.†

G0498.def:
ἀντι-τάσσω (Att..., -ττω) 
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 
to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., Actes 18:6; with dative, Romains 13:2, Jacques 4:6 5:6, 1 Pierre 5:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
